description: This file defines the TimesheetService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It provides functionalities for managing timesheets including creation, data retrieval, and processing of timesheet items, as well as interaction with workflow and data access layers. The class handles complex operations such as generating timesheet data structures, managing states, and enforcing role-based access controls.

classes.name: TimesheetService
classes.description: Service class providing operations to manage and process timesheets, including creation, retrieval, data transformation, state management, and role-based access control within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the AccessFlowStateMachineService instance used to manage workflow state transitions.

methods.name: getTimesheetDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the TimesheetDao instance for database interactions related to timesheets.

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the TimesheetPeriodService instance for managing timesheet periods.

methods.name: getDetailedTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves a detailed representation of a timesheet by its ID, incorporating timesheet data and events.

methods.name: getTimesheetData
methods.description: Generates organized timesheet rows and columns based on the timesheet's date range and items.

methods.name: createTimesheetByDate
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet for a specific week (based on a given date), initializing its date range and state.

methods.name: extractStartDateAndEndDateFromDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week for a given date, respecting the configured week start day.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for an employee on a specific date.

methods.name: createTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Converts an array of input rows into TimesheetItem entities, throwing exceptions if required fields are missing.

methods.name: generateTimesheetItemKey
methods.description: Generates a unique string key for a timesheet item based on its identifiers and date.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates and persists timesheet items based on input rows, updating the database accordingly.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowsForTimesheet
methods.description: Determines the permitted workflow actions for a user on a specific timesheet, considering user roles.
